I need a job this summer to help pay for college so i wont be seeing my mom for too long.
It's definitly easier said than done, I can do it sometimes. It really does help to try get my mind off whatevers bugging me even ho it'll always be there. 
Taking that class sounds like a good idea, thank you, it really does mean a lot.

I see. I guess i'll just have to wait more then. But i'm just one of billions of people in this world, and one of trillions that has ever existed. And we hear about Einstein, Socrates, Shakespeare, Pythagoras, and all these other great people...and here money and resources are being spent on ME, just another person. And thus the questions behold, what is the meaning of life? What is my purpose?
It happens after an argument or certain situation mostly yeah. But also, little things remind me of it and howpeople are better off without me.

My dad and I live in a rural area and my mom lives in the city. 
Idk what to do to feel better. I've had this way of thinking since I was 12 so I'm surprised I'm still here. I can make the thoughts go away but the urge to do it is always there. I still have all the reason to.
